title: TSMC buys $500 million of Anthropic stock in IPO private placement

sources.quote: (“TSMC”) will purchase 6,024,096 shares of our Class N common stock for approximately $500 million.

explain: Alongside Anthropic's stock-market debut, TSMC agreed to buy about $500 million of Anthropic's Class N shares at the IPO price, in a private placement that closes right after the offering.
